service.en: Family residence permit and Emirates ID (private-sector sponsor)
service.ar: إقامة وهوية إماراتية لأفراد الأسرة (كفيل في القطاع الخاص)
service.ur: فیملی رہائش اور ایمریٹس آئی ڈی (نجی شعبے کا کفیل)
service.ml: കുടുംബ താമസ പെർമിറ്റും എമിറേറ്റ്സ് ഐഡിയും (സ്വകാര്യ മേഖല)

about: A resident working in the private sector or a free zone requests residence permits and Emirates IDs for family members.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

timing: Card arrives through an assigned delivery company
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
Provided by Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security
